title: 국립장애인도서관 이용규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00496:20221208:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Libraries Act) <Rule No. 496, December 8, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on December 8, 2022.

Article 2
Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) The Rules on Use of the National Library for the Disabled shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 1, "Article 45 (1) of the Libraries Act" shall be replaced with "Article 24 (1) of the Libraries Act".

In the main sentence of Article 2, "Article 45 (1)" shall be replaced with "Article 24 (1)", and "subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Act" shall be replaced with "subparagraph 2 of Article 3 of the Act".

(2) and (3) Omitted.

Article 4
Omitted.
